Carry out the capacity building of hygiene committees three months (3) after the Project's Effective Date.

Conduct the training evaluation two months (2) after the Project's Effective Date and conduct the training on a regular basis, asnew members join the Project team, throughout the implementation of the Project.
Develop the internal waste management plan consistent with the ICWMP in each of the Project's health centers, three months (3)after the Project's Effective Date

Ensure that all existing Project workers sign the code of conduct one month (1) after the Project Effective Date and all workerssubsequently recruited sign the code of conduct prior to engaging in any works
Implement all the corrective actions of the E&S audit within six (6) months after the Project's Effective Date.
Install all the incinerators purchased under the Parent Project within six (6) months after the Project's Effective Date.
